questiontext.text:
Which method adds an element to the end of a list?
أي دالة تُضيف عنصراً إلى نهاية القائمة؟

feedback.text: Correct / صحيح
add() is not a list method in Python.
insert() adds at a specific index, not necessarily the end.
push() does not exist for Python lists.

questiontext.text:
Which keyword is used to define a function in Python?
أي كلمة مفتاحية تُستخدم لتعريف الدالة في بايثون؟

feedback.text: Correct / صحيح
function is not a Python keyword — use def.
fun is not valid Python syntax.
define is not a Python keyword — use def.

load_csv() does not exist in pandas.

name.text: W8-Q7 — chart for trend over time

questiontext.text:
Which chart type is best for showing a trend over time (e.g. GDP 2000–2023)?
أي مخطط يُظهر الاتجاه الزمني (مثلاً: الناتج المحلي 2000–2023)؟

answer.text: Line chart / المخطط الخطي — ax.plot(x, y)

feedback.text: Correct / صحيح

answer.text: Bar chart / المخطط العمودي — ax.bar(x, y)

feedback.text: Bar charts are better for comparing categories, not time trends.
Histograms show distributions, not time trends.

answer.text: Scatter plot / مخطط الانتشار — ax.scatter(x, y)

feedback.text: Scatter plots show relationships between two variables, not time trends.

questiontext.text:
Your OLS model has R² = 0.85. What does this mean?
نموذج الانحدار أعطى R² = 0.85. ماذا يعني ذلك؟

answer.text: The model explains 85% of the variance in the dependent variable / النموذج يفسّر 85% من تباين المتغير التابع

feedback.text: Correct / صحيح

answer.text: The model has an 85% accuracy rate / دقة النموذج 85%

feedback.text: R² is not accuracy — it measures explained variance.

answer.text: 85% of the coefficients are significant / 85% من المعاملات دالة إحصائياً

feedback.text: Significance is measured by p-values, not R².

answer.text: The model makes errors 15% of the time / النموذج يُخطئ 15% من الوقت

feedback.text: R² does not measure error frequency — it measures explained variance.

questiontext.text:
train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2) — what percentage of data goes to training?
ما النسبة المخصصة للتدريب؟

feedback.text: Correct — test_size=0.2 means 20% test, so 80% train / صحيح
20% is for testing — test_size=0.2.
A 50/50 split would require test_size=0.5.
42 is random_state, not a split percentage.

questiontext.text:
Which metric penalizes large prediction errors more heavily?
أي مقياس يُعاقب الأخطاء الكبيرة في التنبؤ بشكل أكبر؟

answer.text: RMSE — because it squares the errors / لأنه يُربِّع الأخطاء

feedback.text: Correct — squaring makes large errors count much more / صحيح

answer.text: MAE — because it uses absolute values / لأنه يستخدم القيمة المطلقة

feedback.text: MAE treats all errors equally — it does not penalize large errors more.

answer.text: R² — because it measures explained variance / لأنه يقيس التباين المُفسَّر

feedback.text: R² is not an error metric.
MAE and RMSE differ — RMSE is always ≥ MAE.
